Mid-Fi Electronics browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Mid-Fi Electronics Overdrive Published on November 5, 2013 Mid-Fi Electronics overdrive pedal Information Mid-Fi Electronics It's an overdrive that responds like a cranked amp (or some of them at least) actually does. The clipping part of the circuit is input controlled, so when you play lightly, that part of the circuit is moved away. Doing this makes it actually feel like you are playing through a cranked amp, even at whisper quiet volume. The alnico side of the switch has a narrower frequency range and is more compressed, the ceramic side is more open with more highs and lows. This pedal is SUPER touch sensitive, allowing you to play super blown out chords with clean notes right on top.
